# Resilience rules — planned, not implemented

For each applicable component, define retry policy and retry safety; idempotency key/strategy; duplicate execution prevention; partial failure handling; compensation or recovery; timeouts; unavailable dependencies; missing permissions; user-facing error; safe stop; escalation; connection references; environment variables; secrets; logging/correlation; and observable DLP/policy dependencies. State where a concern is not applicable with rationale. Do not claim hidden tenant policies are observable.
